notes.content: [p]Grab your gear! Gunslugs: Rogue Tactics get’s a big quality of life patch for PC.[/p][h2]New Content:[/h2][list][*][p]Improved default input settings for Gamepad and Keyboard[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Window resolutions and toggling Fullscreen mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added Steam Cloud saving[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703896/1671e3026dc8fe6ceae5728c1dc9108dc6f52b0c.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Words from the Developer:[/h2][p]So this is a much overdue Quality of Life Patch for Gunslugs: Rogue Tactics. notes.title: OrangePixel releases Regulators - A unique single player action shooter that plays and feels like a co-op multiplayer game.
notes.content:
Pl[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/9856238/e2a9c85834e36da21e9d25463d698b44c9de18e6.jpg[/img]

The new OrangePixel game Regulators is NOW available, please come check it out:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892750/Regulators/


REGULATORS puts you in charge of a small squad of mercenaries hired to clear the city from mutating villains in this top-down tactical shooter game. 
Enter buildings from the streets, rooftops or sewers, and complete mission goals to locate the scientist commanding the mutating villains. And take them all out!

A unique single player real-time action game that feels like a co-op multiplayer game with NPC-mercenaries following the player’s lead.

notes.title: Gauntlet of Power Patch 4: The Temple and the Rogue
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/9856238/0b247cbcf9759b91fa6e46431fc13a77875890ed.jpg[/img]

The new update for Heroes of Loot: Gauntlet of Power is now live! 

[h1]New Content:[/h1]

– Hidden realm: The Temple
– New unlockable character: The Rogue
– New friendlies
– New enemies

Grab the update now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2374320/Heroes_Of__Loot_Gauntlet_Of_Power/

[h2]More info:[/h2]

Besides adding the new realm and characters, I made some small changes to balancing things out (especially for the easy mode).

I also made the realms more of a choice to go into or not, as it will mean you now skip one or two levels. So if you are in a hurry and want to speedrun the game, knowing where to find the entries to these realms is certainly key.. but I can imagine it might sometimes be more interesting to NOT take the realm-route and grab some extra loot in the levels you would otherwise skip.

If you need a little spoiler on how/where to find the Rogue unlock tokens, make sure to check the Orangepixel website for the Games Wiki.

notes.title: Come play: Sir Questionnaire
notes.content:
Hi guys! Just wanted to let you know that I just pushed the release button on a new Orangepixel Steam release:  Sir Questionnaire!

It's a quirky game at a bargain price, it provides hours of gameplay in a VERY small package:  The game is played in single dungeon rooms, where you are given the choice to either "interact" or "get outta there!".

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9856238/31225943fe2d8e4c0b171ac3119acb2f38bb5b22.gif[/img]

Do you attack the skulls? got enough health? got the right weapon for the lobsters? Got some magic left to hit the huge Wolf on his head? Dare to drink the milk before the next encounter? 

A game of choices - how far can you venture into the dungeon?  Come play Sir Questionnaire, and make sure to drop by on discord if you need tips & tricks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124790/Sir_Questionnaire

notes.title: v1.0.8 - attempt to tackle controller issues
notes.content:
There have been some issues left and right with controllers and buttons not working or doing more than one thing at a time.

Problem is that the same controller and OS combination works for some players, where it doesn't work for others.. which makes it very hard to find the problem.   IF you have issues let me know which controller you have, which OS and IF you are using any controller mapping tools or settings that might change the behavior in some way.

The changes in this version might mean you have to remap the gamepad settings, or do a "Reset to default" and then change them to your liking.

I removed some code that hard-assigned buttons to the interface portions of the game, which probably caused more troubles than they fixed (compared to my other games where these issues were happening much less).  So I reverted all that code back to the normal state of my games, and I hope that fixes some issues for people that had buttons trigger multiple actions.


Also check the gamepad dead-zone setting in the menu, because that might help with left+right movement issues (if you're gamepad has seen some battle time in games over the years, those sticks can get really funky with triggering responses).

I don't think it fixes all the problems, but do let me know if it did fix a bunch of them, and then let me know what issues still remain!

notes.title: Closing in on RELEASE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34703896/9f5a5f412c234a25f94e6208c8b336d37c3b11d4.gif[/img]

I just pushed v0.8.0 to Patreon supporters, and this contains a lot of the fixes based on the feedback from the public-beta a few weeks ago. Check out some gameplay video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MxOycdo3qM4

The biggest change is the manual-aiming, which is now possible when playing with keyboard+mouse or with gamepad. It’s purely optional, so you can ignore it if you prefer the auto-aim, but especially on gamepad it’s very flexible to just use that right-stick to really target an enemy now and then.

This build does also come with some new cool things, we now have guard-towers,  enemy trucks, sticky-bombs, landmines, crouching, and a few new missions/objectives in the rotation. 

[h1]Todo[/h1]
The big things on my to-do list are : finishing those boss-battles, adding one more world, and focus my fine-tuning efforts on the Arctic and Egypt worlds, which still have some things going on that need fixing.

Let’s see if I can get all that done in the next 1-3 weeks and then have a release build available… wow!

Don't forget to come and hang out in discord.gg/orangepixel with a chance to win a copy on release!
